experiment: One fresh REA-assisted full-app reconstruction per build; separate from six planner-only V2 trials.
verdict: The protected first submission took longer and had 54 suboptimal plans; runnable and persistent does not establish behavioral equivalence. This single pair does not establish a general failure rate or causal mean effort increase.
control: Original-vs-original passed 396/396; deliberate bad objective rejected by exact and semantic graders. Actual hardened original matched 312/312.
environmentLimit: Both in-trial REA scans emitted complete JSON but exited during sandbox process-table cleanup, on unsupported Node patch 24.13.1. Post-submission scans outside sandbox with explicit Node24.22.2 exited zero for both; no feedback or revised candidates.
diagnosis: Separate in-memory incumbent-comparison repair matches 312/312; official protected submission remains 258/312.
scope: Static REA reports plus direct artifact inspection by an AI analyst; no REA-alone incremental comparison.
312 distinct fresh-batch plan cases plus selected persistence, conflict, validation and expiry checks; not exhaustive app proof.
Shared legacy quote feature is outside the hardening treatment.
Requested model alias matches across trials but resolved backend identity is not independently attested.
